# Essar Sons Group

> We are a company with 40 years of experience of dealing in Architectural glass solutions, glass trade, facade and fenestration work and construction.

## Pages
- [Home](https://essarsons.com/): Glass, aluminium and structural solutions engineered with precision and delivered with care.
- [About](https://essarsons.com/about): For more than 40 years, Essar has been a leader in the glass industry, manufacturing both structural and decorative glass.
- [Our Businesses](https://essarsons.com/businesses): One company, one standard, multiple businesses — the five divisions of Essar Sons Group, each managed by its own specialist firm.
- [Projects](https://essarsons.com/projects): Real projects delivered across architectural glass, wholesale supply, fabrication and construction, filterable by division.
- [Contact](https://essarsons.com/contact): Contact details and addresses for the head office and all five business divisions.
- [Architectural Glass Solutions](https://essarsons.com/business/architectural-glass): Premium processed and specialty glass — engineered to spec, priced fairly, delivered on time.
- [Glass Imports and Trading](https://essarsons.com/business/glass-wholesale): Wholesale supplier of architectural glass across Maharashtra — top brands, delivered swiftly.
- [Facade and Fenestration](https://essarsons.com/business/windoors): Expert aluminium and glass fabrication — windows, doors and fenestration systems.
- [Industrial Lifting, Material Handling and Rigging Solutions](https://essarsons.com/business/lifters): Nationwide supplier of lifting tackle and material handling equipment.
- [Construction](https://essarsons.com/business/constructions): Builder of high-rise residential and commercial spaces in Mumbai.
